_doc: Credit lines a publisher requires, by source family (registry_id). This file decides NOTHING about which records may appear: under the national source policy of 2026-11-01 (docs/national-source-policy-2026-11-01.md) every record a wired connector stamps with its source family and official record link is eligible. A source absent here simply carries no credit line. Each entry names the publisher's own recorded requirement in `_evidence`; test/no-source-allowlist.test.mjs checks it.
